Definition: neuter of a presumed derivative of G1382; a testing; by implication, trustworthiness:--trial, trying.
BiblicalUsage: The trying of faith, as James says the trying of your faith works patience, and Peter says it is more precious than gold that perishes.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the trying of my faith is not God doubting me but God proving me, and patience is the proof.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
